description: This file is a shell script used for testing support of diff format verbose submodule differences in git diff. It contains test cases, utility functions, and setup steps related to Git submodule diff behavior.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds files and commits them to a Git repository, optionally encoding file contents based on prerequisites.

methods.name: commit_file
methods.description: Creates a commit with a message for the Git repository.

methods.name: diff_cmp
methods.description: Compares two diff output files after normalization.
